download.button: Download vanilla assets (about 45 MB, from Mojang's official servers)
download.note: This connects to Mojang's official servers (piston-meta.mojang.com, piston-data.mojang.com) and downloads the latest Minecraft Java Edition release client jar into this app's data folder on your computer. Only its textures are read. No personal information is sent and nothing updates automatically; the app only goes online when you click this button.

errors.network: Couldn't reach Mojang's servers. Check your connection and try again.
errors.verify: The downloaded file failed verification and was discarded. Please try again.
errors.disk: Couldn't write to the app's data folder (disk full or no permission).
errors.unknown: The download failed. Please try again.

onboarding.title: No assets yet
onboarding.body: {{name}} doesn't ship Minecraft's textures. Use the game installed on this computer, download the vanilla assets from Mojang's official servers, or add your own resource pack. Until then, missing textures show as magenta and black squares in the preview.

discovery.title: Found your Minecraft
discovery.body: Minecraft Java Edition {{version}} was detected. With the game's own textures and sounds, previews and exports look just like the game.
discovery.local: {{name}} only reads these files on this computer. It never copies, uploads or changes them.
discovery.later: You can change this any time under “Assets”.
